cohort: 152 women with singleton pregnancies who underwent caesarean section and 152 women with normal deliveries
finding: Parity, booking status, maternal height, maternal weight, birth weight, previous caesarean section, and ante-partum bleeding were significant predictors of caesarean section, while maternal age was not.
mod_finding: This study investigated predictive factors for cesarean section and found that parity, booking status, maternal height and weight, birth weight, previous cesarean section, and antepartum bleeding were significant predictors.
